meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
700 रुपये के अंदर **acne-prone skin** ke liye main **salicylic acid serum** ya **niacinamide serum** recommend karunga, aur *active pimples + oily skin* ke liye सबसे practical pick **2% salicylic acid** hota hai.[4][6][7][11]

**Best picks under ₹700:**

- **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acne Control Serum** — लगभग **₹399–₹467**; oily, acne-prone aur sensitive skin ke liye suitable बताया गया है.[4][7]
- **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — लगभग **₹222**; acne marks aur oil control ke liye budget-friendly option है.[1]
- **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum** — sale price लगभग **₹599.25**; acne, blackheads aur open pores ke liye targeted serum है.[9]
- **Pilgrim 10% Niacinamide Face Serum** — लगभग **₹649**; acne marks aur uneven skin tone ke liye useful बताया गया है.[5]
- **Simple 10% Niacinamide Booster Serum** — लगभग **₹548**; acne-prone skin ke liye a moderate-strength niacinamide option है.[17]

Agar aapki skin **oily + active pimples** wali hai, to **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic** ya **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid** zyada useful rahenge.[4][7][9][11]  
Agar zyada problem **marks, post-acne pigmentation, aur oiliness** hai, to **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide** ya **Simple 10% Niacinamide** better choice hogi.[1][17]

**Meri short recommendation:**
- **Active pimples / clogged pores:** **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic**
- **Acne marks + oil control:** **The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide**
- **Balanced all-round budget pick:** **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid Face Serum**[1][4][7][9]

Agar chaho, main tumhari **skin type** ke hisaab se 1 exact serum pick karke de sakta hoon:
- **oily**
- **dry**
- **sensitive**
- **combination**
